deterministic_interface_break.consumer_behavior: _viable_candidates rejects every candidate whose discovery_source != APT_CATALOG
deterministic_interface_break.consequence: The inherited verified suppliers cannot enter the existing apt_cli_probe → cli_contract_inference → cli_command → independent verification loop.

adjacent_interface_risk.observed: auto_apt_cli_acquisition also applies legacy score >= 12 admission while the Xapian route emits BM25 weights.
adjacent_interface_risk.reason: A source-string-only patch could still reject all otherwise valid Xapian candidates because score scales are not guaranteed compatible.

pr111_selection_defect.defect: The candidate comparison evaluated only new capability families and omitted the known unresolved end-to-end integration seam inside TOOL_DISCOVERY_SELECTION_AND_LEARNING.
pr111_selection_defect.qualitative_metric_issue: PR111 used HIGH/LOW-style estimates without a measured comparison against this deterministic small integration seam.
pr111_selection_defect.effect: The demotion of the tool-learning residual was not causally justified by the recorded comparison.

decision.why: Correctness/truth precedes local momentum. Restore the omitted known blocker, close or falsify the smallest interface seam, then recompute globally with multi-tool orchestration still available.
